mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) compresses discount rates and stimulates equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE > 5.0%) indicates economic weakness that reduces corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in payrolls (PAYEMS) and rises in unemployment (UNRATE) signal a deteriorating labor market, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST declines in a late-cycle expansion regime.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 95) indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 95.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in real personal consumption (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate a broad-based consumer sector slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS and HOUST both decline.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 220) signals persistent price pressures that prompt central bank tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 220.

mechanism_narrative: Weak economic growth (GDPC1 < 13000) reflects slowing aggregate demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 < 13000.
